fact: Agence Ecofin reports Congo is among 16 countries Starlink marks 'Starting in 2026' on its map, shown in the colour for pending regulatory authorisation, and that service was still not available in Congo despite a 2025 forecast.
Le360 lists Congo-Brazzaville as 'available from 2026' with no licence granted to Starlink as of May 2026.
ARPCE seized an unauthorised Starlink installation in Congo-Brazzaville in June 2024.
